scenarios.name: Close the Sketch Constrain area and its menu on a tab switch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited
the full Sketch ribbon is selected
the Constrain additional-command area is open
the user right-clicks Constraint Inference Scope in the additional area
the Constrain area context menu is visible
the Constrain additional-command area remains open
the user selects the Tools tab
the context menu and Constrain additional-command area close
the full Tools ribbon is visible
the user selects the Sketch tab
the full Sketch ribbon is visible
the Constrain additional-command area remains closed
